App.Title: Cypher Business
App.NoBusiness: No business exists yet. The GM can create the first one.
App.DeleteConfirm: Delete "{name}" and all its history? This cannot be undone.
App.ManagersHint: Choose which players may view this business and request week runs (GM approves; editing is GM-only)
App.ManagersWhat: Managers see every tab and can ask you to run the week — they cannot edit anything. Uncheck everyone to keep the business GM-eyes only.
App.NoPlayers: No player users in this world.

Data.ExportHint: Download a JSON backup of ALL businesses (state, staff, events, history)
Data.ImportHint: Replace ALL businesses from a backup JSON file (older backups auto-upgrade)
Data.ImportConfirm: Replace ALL current businesses with {n} from "{file}"? This cannot be undone — export first if unsure.
Data.ImportParseFailed: That file is not valid JSON.
Data.ImportInvalid: That file is not a Cypher Business backup ({reason}).

Float.NoBusiness: No business yet — the GM creates the first one.
Float.DragHint: Click to open · drag to move

Main.RunAllHint: Run a week for every business (GM)
Main.NoCalendaria: Calendaria not active — weeks use an internal counter
Main.PreviewHint: Projected ledger for the coming week
Main.TrendsHint: Weekly income, expenses and attribute trends
Main.LedgerPairHint: Projected for the coming week — updates live as you move the sliders above. Net = income after wages, spending and cost of goods.

Report.NothingToPlot: Nothing to plot yet — run a week first.
Report.ForecastNote: Expected baseline — the weekly event and rival moves still roll when the week runs.

Spend.MaintenanceHint: keeps facilities standing, calms the streets
Spend.WagesHint: Below 100% erodes crew morale and risks quits (60% bites hard); above 100% buys goodwill.
Spend.WageLavish: lavish — the district hears of it

Role.DragHint: Drag an actor from the sidebar onto a role to assign it.
Role.PCHint: A player character holds this post — stat tracking applies to NPC actors only.
Role.ProductivityHint: Feeds the weekly income multiplier. A productive roster earns more from the same demand.
Role.MoraleHint: Chases the business mood. Low morale drags this leader's productivity down; high morale lifts it — and the overall morale with it.
Role.LoyaltyHint: Erodes when morale drops, problems fester or events sour the crew. At zero, the leader walks out for good.
Role.StrengthHint: Derived: the mean of productivity, morale and loyalty. No direct edits — it follows those three.
Role.NotesHint: Panel notes — hover to read, click to edit
Role.NotesEmpty: No notes yet — click the note icon to write some.
Role.WageHint: Weekly base wage for this post. Charged only while someone holds it — scaled by the wage level and any finance discounts.

leadership.Label: Leadership
leadership.Desc: The face of the business. Filled leaders push the Leadership attribute toward its target and add weight against rival moves. Their productivity feeds the weekly income multiplier.

operations.Label: Operations
operations.Desc: Runs the shop floor. Operations roles stretch the same crew across more line demand — each point of ops power lifts the staffing floor by 5% (up to +25%).

marketing.Label: Marketing
marketing.Desc: Sells the dream. Marketing roles widen the demand factor, pushing more units out the door each week.

finance.Label: Finance
finance.Desc: Watches the coin. Finance roles cut wages, marketing and upkeep bills — up to 20% off the weekly spending.

security.Label: Security
security.Desc: Keeps knives in drawers. Security roles blunt rival attacks and calm the neighborhood, softening the danger drift.

LW.Title: Leading Workers
LW.Hint: Promoted crew. Drag actors onto the slots — they carry the same stats as leadership and feed the engine at half weight. Each filled slot adds up to +1% income by strength.
LW.CrewHint: Put this lead on the floor — adds them to the personnel roster as a paid worker (uncheck to pull them back off)

Worker.Name: Name
Worker.EffectivenessHint: derived from morale + productivity; drives production capacity
Worker.LeadingTag: Leading worker — on the floor via the Leadership tab
Worker.ProbationHint: Probation — the books open after the first month
Worker.ExportDone: Dossier posted to chat and copied to the clipboard.
Worker.None: Nobody on payroll yet. Hire some workers or roll a crew.

Events.NoPending: No open events. The dice are kind this week.
Events.NoJournal: Nothing resolved yet. The story is just beginning.
Events.JournalClearHint: GM: permanently delete the checked journal entries. History is scrubbed — nothing is re-run.
Events.JournalNoneSelected: Tick at least one journal entry first.
Events.JournalClearedLog: {count} journal entries cleared from the record (GM).
Events.ForceHint: GM: roll an extra story event on top of the weekly one (never blocked).
Events.Forced: the GM forced a new event

Stakes.Fire: the least productive worker is fired
Stakes.Walkout: the least loyal leader walks out

CatInfo.global: The world at large — politics, weather, war, fashion. Nobody is immune.
CatInfo.business: Internal trouble: bookkeeping, suppliers, promises, paperwork.
CatInfo.leadership: Your own command structure — egos, schemes, resignations.
CatInfo.personnel: The crew: accidents, grievances, and the wrong person in the wrong job.
CatInfo.competition: Rivals making moves — they always attack your weakest flank.
CatInfo.facility: The physical plant: boilers, roofs, rats, and everything that can break.
CatInfo.product: What you sell — quality scares, bad batches, missed trends.
CatInfo.crisis: The house is on fire. Serious trouble with real teeth — resolve it fast.

Events.SeverityHint: Cypher difficulty 1-10. Higher severity means more steps on bold plans and harsher failure stakes.
Events.LogStepHint: GM: mark one table step done for this way out (e.g. a scene, a roll, a negotiation)
Events.SuccessLocked: log all steps to declare success
Events.PlayerHint: The GM is working on this. Watch the table, not the ledger.
Events.DcHint: Target number for a roll against this event (difficulty × 3)
Events.LinkRollHint: GM: the next roll in chat resolves this way out — total vs DC. Click again to cancel. 90s window.
Events.LinkExpired: Roll link expired — no roll in time
Events.LinkResolvedAlready: That event is no longer pending (already resolved or expired).

Comp.Hint: Each week every rival tests Aggression + d6 against your Marketing + Leadership + d6. Winning big steals demand; losing badly costs you marketing.
Comp.None: No rivals — for now. The market abhors a vacuum.
Comp.FocusHint: Their method of operations — what they actually do to hurt you.
Comp.DescPlaceholder: What is this house, and why do they hate you?
Comp.GenDescHint: Regenerate the house description from its M.O. and temperament.
Comp.RerollFigureHint: Replace this figure with a freshly rolled one (keeps the slot).
Comp.FigureTitleHint: Their office in the house — The Money, The Face, Chief Enforcer…
Comp.PressureHint: Builds when the rival wins the weekly market contest. At 10 they make a move — an event lands on the Events tab. Dealing with the event, or beating them weekly, eases it.
Comp.IntelToggle: Show / hide the rival's profile: modus operandi, products & services, facilities

Fac.Hint: Facilities set capacity and drive the weekly efficiency multiplier and the crew's mood. Condition decays without upkeep.
Fac.None: No facilities. Working out of a back room (50% efficiency).
Fac.ConditionHint: Drives production efficiency; the crew's morale drifts toward it each week.
Fac.RenovateHint: Pay {cost} shins to restore +{gain}% condition on the spot.
Fac.RenovateBroke: Not enough cash in the treasury to renovate.
Fac.RenovatePristine: This facility is already in perfect shape.
Fac.CapacityHint: Personnel the premises can hold. Exceed total capacity and cramped quarters sour morale.
Fac.VisitHint: Travel to this facility's scene (this client only)
Fac.DropScene: Drop a scene from the sidebar to give this card its image and a visit button

Prod.Hint: Active lines sell weekly: demand × marketing, scaled by facility condition and throttled by staffing — each line lists its crew requirement. Value is the per-unit profit. Demand drifts back to its baseline.
Prod.ValueHint: Profit per unit sold, in shins — the crew's productivity adds a price premium on top.
Prod.WorkersHint: Headcount this line takes to run at full tilt. Short on workers and every line scales down proportionally.
Prod.DemandHint: Weekly pull for this line, scaled by the marketing attribute. Rivals can undercut it; it drifts back toward the base each week.
Prod.BaseDemandHint: The baseline demand settles toward — raise it with marketing pushes and good weeks.
Prod.StaffHint: Workers on the payroll versus the headcount the active lines demand. Hire or slim the catalogue to close the gap.
Prod.DropItem: Drop an item from the sidebar to give this card its image

Socket.NotManager: You are not a manager of this business.
Socket.RequestSent: Week request sent to the GM.
Socket.WeekRequestText: {user} wants to run a week for "{business}".
Socket.AlreadyRan: Another GM already ran this week.

Theme.Name: Theme
Theme.Hint: Visual theme for all Cypher Business windows (per user).

CanvasIcon.Name: Floating canvas button
CanvasIcon.Hint: Show the draggable Cypher Business medallion on the game canvas.
